question: PF-A built va_seal_enumerated_seven_year-set and va_seal_ancillary_matter_only-set on CC-1203 where the PF01 assignment table named CC-1201. VF-SRC-A verified the builder used the form it claims but declined to ratify the deviation on the builder's own reasoning, returning BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT: the answer 'turns on what the two forms print on their faces (the enumerated statutes; whether Section C admits a standalone ancillary matter)' — pages in the corpus no verifier could then reach.
determination: CC-1203 is the correct form for both families. The assignment table was wrong; PF-A's deviation was right.

CC-1201.titleLine: PETITION FOR SEALING PURSUANT TO VA. CODE § 19.2-392.12 (Misdemeanors, Class 5 or 6 felonies, § 18.2-95, and felony offenses punished as larceny that resulted in conviction or deferral/dismissal and any related ancillary matters)

CC-1203.titleLine: PETITION FOR SEALING PURSUANT TO VA. CODE § 19.2-392.12:1(A) AND/OR (B) (Specific misdemeanor convictions or deferred dismissals and any related ancillary matters; And/or ancillary matters related to previously sealed charges or convictions)

perFamily.va_seal_enumerated_seven_year-set: the enumerated seven-year route is a § 19.2-392.12:1 route; CC-1203's face names exactly 'specific misdemeanor convictions or deferred dismissals' under 12:1(A)/(B). CC-1201 is the § 19.2-392.12 general petition and does not cite 12:1 anywhere in its body.
perFamily.va_seal_ancillary_matter_only-set: the open question — whether the form admits a STANDALONE ancillary matter — is answered on CC-1203's own title line: 'And/or ancillary matters related to previously sealed charges or convictions'. CC-1201 admits ancillary matters only as related to a charge in the petition itself.

whatThisIsAndIsNot: A form-scope determination read from the official forms' printed faces — the same class as a field-classification decision, not a new legal route. It ratifies no eligibility judgement. Counsel review remains a post-build gate for approved_for_live exactly as before; this unblocks verification, not launch.
actions: the two families' BLOCKED_LEGAL_INPUT on form identity is resolved for verification purposes
all four VA families dispatched for a full second read with the corpus available
